allowed.development_folds: fit, early stopping, comparison and predeclared selection
allowed.evaluation_folds: evaluate the ALREADY CHOSEN spec once; never used to choose

forbidden: reinterpreting fold roles after seeing results
using any fold whose TEST overlaps another fold's validation as independent evidence

claims_allowed: evaluation folds: INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION_METRIC for the precommitted spec only

purposes.DESCRIPTIVE_REPORT: any completed fold; never independent evidence
purposes.INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION: evaluation folds only, precommitted specs only, and the TEST window must not overlap any segment of any development fold
